dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Everything's fine. If I had to complain about anything, it's that no one's got time to play cards with me... But now that I think about it, I'm at work right now myself.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Mmm, if I play like this next time, an epic victory will be mine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Victory in what?

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: In a duel, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: I've got all the Saurian blessing cards — I mean, all the Saurian cards — plus a deck with Saurian feathers... *ahem* I mean, the latest custom cards...

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: So I'll be invincible come the next match! Victory is 100% guaranteed to the proudest of players — and that's me, bay-bee!

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Of course, I still have to thank my teacher, Acat, for carefully drawing up a deck of Qucusaurus cards for me. I wish her business at Chuwen Fair all the prosperity it deserves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: I will, because I've got the blessing of the Saurians!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I thought you were talking about combat...

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Ah, if it's combat we're talking about, then the cool factor doesn't really apply, right? That's a whole different kettle of fish from tabletop card games.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: I may have gotten a little heated just now when talking about Genius Invokation TCG, but please don't paint me as some sort of battle-freak.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Even if a warrior staggers off the battlefield, if they defeat their enemy and make it back home alive, then they're the final winners nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Wasn't I cool back there? My heroic stance and all!

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: I lost...? Looks like I can't call myself "cool" quite yet...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is pretty cool too.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: ...I tried to imagine it, and what you said does make sense.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: But I must say, the battlefield's no place for those who just want to look cool! Winning is what matters.
